description: The CLARITY Act — US crypto market-structure legislation that would assign clear SEC/CFTC jurisdiction and de-risk token issuance/custody for institutions — is at the Senate committee stage but NOT floor-voted, with 2026 enactment odds cut to ~48-50% (Galaxy from 75%, Polymarket ~48%) on a tightening Senate calendar. The stablecoin leg cleared Senate Banking 15-9. This is the idiosyncratic BINARY re-rating catalyst for crypto_infrastructure: passage would be a durable structural positive (regulatory certainty unlocks institutional allocation), failure keeps the status quo. It sits against a bearish near-term macro backdrop the sector is NOT credited for here (Fed hawkish pivot, record ~$4.4B spot-BTC-ETF outflows, BTC ~$59-62K) — so treat crypto_infrastructure's catalyst_alignment as reflecting REGULATORY OPTIONALITY only, with the macro headwind carried in the study narrative and the composite's momentum/flow legs. Moderate strength: high magnitude x ~50% probability.
user_notes: Registered 2026-07-01 in the sectors-without-catalyst review. The sector-specific binary catalyst for crypto_infrastructure. relation_to_structural='independent' so it contributes its decayed strength as a standalone positive term — deliberately the ONLY catalyst linked to crypto, because the dominant macro driver (Fed hawkish pivot, ETF outflows) is a HEADWIND that must not be added as a positive alignment term; that bearishness lives in the study narrative + the composite's momentum/flow legs. strength 55 reflects high magnitude x ~50% passage odds; is_priced_in 0.25. Re-score UP on a Senate floor vote / passage, DOWN toward decayed if the bill dies in the 2026 session. This gives crypto a documented forward catalyst without pretending the macro tape is bullish.
